name: GraphProjection
documentation:
Configures an asynchronous materialized search document containing a complete model graph.

Configure this through {@link Model#graphProjection()} and enable it with {@link Model#materializeGraph()}. Without an explicit {@link #collection()}, Fluxzero appends {@code -graphs} to the resolved direct-model collection when the root is searchable, or to the simple model name otherwise. An explicit collection remains available when that durable public search contract needs a custom name.

methods.name: collection
methods.documentation:
Distinct collection receiving materialized graph documents. Blank derives from the public direct-model collection
 when enabled, or from the simple root-model name otherwise.

methods.name: completion
methods.documentation: Default result-completion behavior for commits affecting this root projection.

methods.name: pathOverrides
methods.documentation: Optional projection-local replacements for canonical relationship paths.
